# The Shadow Bridge

> Connecting families with verified Shadow Teachers, Special Education Home Tutors, and Specialized Therapists across India.

## About The Shadow Bridge
The Shadow Bridge (founded by Pratibha Mishra) is an educational and clinical matchmaking platform based in India. It bridges the gap in inclusive education by pairing children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), ADHD, Down Syndrome, speech delays, learning disabilities, and developmental delays with qualified in-classroom Shadow Teachers and home-based Special Needs Tutors.

## Core Offerings & Placement-Based Pricing Model

- **Intake Clinical Consultation (₹99)**: A structured 1-on-1 discussion with our educational mentor to evaluate the child's developmental profile, IEP goals, school guidelines, and locality.
- **Shadow Teacher Placement (₹5,000 one-time placement fee)**: A trained educator who accompanies a child inside mainstream classrooms during school hours to foster focus, prompt following, sensory regulation, and peer social interaction, working towards gradual independence.
- **Special Education Home Tutor (₹5,000 one-time placement fee)**: Individualized 1-on-1 academic reinforcement at home tailored to the child's learning pace and sensory needs.
- **Home Therapy Sessions (₹3,000 booking)**: Dedicated in-home 1-on-1 clinical sessions in Delhi NCR (ABA Therapy, Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Special Education, Behavior Therapy, Physical Therapy, Play Therapy, Counseling).
- **Online Parent Training (PAN-India Virtual)**: Live 1-on-1 virtual coaching equipping parents with meltdown management, visual routines, and positive reinforcement strategies.
- **School Collaboration (₹10,000 institutional placement)**: Supporting mainstream schools with trained shadow educators, IEP integration, and inclusive classroom assistance.

## Geographic Coverage
- **In-Person Services (Shadow Teaching & Home Tutoring)**: Delhi NCR (Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, Faridabad), Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune.
- **Home Therapy Sessions**: Delhi NCR.
- **Virtual Services (Online Parent Training & ABA Online)**: Available PAN-India across all states and union territories.
